name: AnimatedContent-TS-TW
title: Animated Content
description: Wraps children; animates slide-in on scroll with customizable distance, direction, scale, and opacity. Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll detection. Optionally disappears after a delay.
use: Reveal content on scroll, add entrance animations to sections, or create depth with staggered reveals.
avoid: Reduced motion preference; no prefers-reduced-motion handling. GSAP requires license considerations.
a11y: Starts invisible; content becomes visible via animation. No aria attributes; depends on semantic structure.
